title: FBI-UAP-D033, FD-302, “Thermally Elevated Aerial Object,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview report regarding a UAP sighting by a Special Agent in 2026, containing significant redactions of names and specific dates.

incidents.summary: A U.S. Government Special Agent observed a thermally elevated aerial object flying southbound in the western United States.
incidents.quote: the object presented as a hot aerial object through thermal observation
incidents.size: approximately half the size of a Black Hawk helicopter
